picks.title: OmniRoute
picks.summary: Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers and 500+ models with quota-aware auto-fallback.
picks.implementation_idea: A startup or indie team can front their LLM app calls with OmniRoute for quota-aware provider fallback and token-compression savings across 500+ models.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed

picks.title: Paperclip: the app people use to manage agents at work
picks.summary: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents: org charts, budgets, governance, heartbeats and a ticket system in one dashboard.
picks.implementation_idea: A small team can run a multi-agent operations setup as a Paperclip org: one agent per role, with per-agent token budgets, approval gates, and a shared ticket system.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed

picks.title: DeepSeek Harness: everything-is-a-plugin agent harness
picks.summary: DeepSeek's official agent harness where every capability ships as a plugin, making agent stacks composable and swappable.
picks.implementation_idea: A developer can write small plugins for the harness, for example one plugin per data source, feeding a scoring and dedupe layer that keeps only what is worth acting on.

picks.title: Nasiko: developer control plane for AI agents
picks.summary: Rust control plane giving developers one dashboard to deploy, monitor, and govern fleets of AI agents.
picks.implementation_idea: A team running multiple coding agents can put nasiko in front of them: one control plane with per-worker kill-switches, spend caps, and cost visibility.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed
